A friend asks if you can build a small site for his bakery. Your sports club is on WordPress. The church is paying too much for something that promised too much.

You know what you should do about it. You also know the objection. Plone is overkill for that, and you will drown in Docker images and GitHub Actions workflows before the bakery has a homepage.

Maastricht, 21–27 September.

https://2026.ploneconf.org/
